name: SEX LIFE
source:
Maria and Marimo are twin sisters and look almost the same. One day, the main character moves to an apartment, but there are already two girls living. Yes, they are Maria and Marimo. "Ok, you can live here with us, but pay for rent and food."

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
玛丽亚与真理藻是一对双胞胎姐妹，长得几乎一模一样。一天，主人公搬进一间公寓，却发现里面已经住着两个姑娘。没错，正是玛丽亚和真理藻。“好吧，你可以和我们一起住，但房租和伙食费要照付。”

[From ErogeShop]
